name: classify_aec_entities
author: hprebar
title: Classify AEC entities
description: Reads entities as AEC objects: StructuralColumn / StructuralBeam / StructuralWall / StructuralSlab / StructuralOpening / StructuralGrid, ArchitecturalWall / Door / Window / Room / Stair / Furniture, Pipe / Duct / CableTray / Equipment / Fixture / Terminal / Fitting — each with a confidence, the evidence (layer, block name, closed footprint and size, nearby text mark) and dimensions in mm (width x depth, length, area, orientation, centroid, diameter). Rules come from a JSON rule set (embedded default, or a project file under the MCP server's rules folder) matching layer wildcards, entity types, block names, closed/open, size ranges, aspect ratio and text. Use this before any structural, architectural or MEP question, when the user asks 'what is this', 'find the columns/beams/walls/pipes/doors', or to feed handles into relationship, connectivity, clash or schedule tools. Read-only.

filter.description: Which entities to consider. Types, layers and block names accept AutoCAD wildcards (* and ?) and comma lists; handles short-circuit everything else.

types.description: DXF names: LINE, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, ELLIPSE, SPLINE, HATCH, SOLID, INSERT (block reference), TEXT, MTEXT, DIMENSION, LEADER, MULTILEADER…

colors.description: ACI index as text ("1"), "ByLayer", "ByBlock" or a true-colour name

blockNames.description: Block definition names or wildcards (INSERT entities only)

textContains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the text / dimension text / block attribute values

handles.description: Exact entity handles (hex); when given, the other criteria only narrow this list

visibleOnly.description: Skip invisible entities and entities on off/frozen layers

space.description: model (default), current (the active layout), all, or a layout name

handles.description: Classify exactly these entities instead of a filter

disciplines.description: Only rules of these disciplines; omit for all

minConfidence.description: Drop objects below this confidence (they count as unknown)

includeUnknown.description: Also return entities no rule matched, as aecType Unknown with the runner-up rules

ruleSet.description: default (embedded), user (rules\aec-classification.json beside the server registry) or the name of another JSON file there; omitted = user if present, else default

limit.description: Objects per page (an object with evidence and dimensions is ~0.5–1 KB; 50 keeps the answer under the 64 KB cap)
